## What this dashboard shows

- This dashboard documents the group's unified finance ontology: a single graph model in Snowflake connecting ownership, KPIs, and ERP data, published through a semantic view for both reporting pages and the agent.
- The model contains **9 classes**, **10 relations**, **65 things (nodes)** and **130 links**, with **5 of 12 semantic view tables** live and **5 ontology verified questions** defined.
- **Integrity check, live: 0 links to a missing node, 0 duplicate IDs**.

## What to report

- The ontology provides one spine to answer cross-cutting board questions (ownership → stake → KPI → ledger) without maintaining separate master data; each thing has one ID and the three use cases (CFO, CIO/CTO, CINVO) walk the same graph.
- Coverage: **11 legal entities**, **5 companies**, **3 businesses**, **5 ERP ledgers**, **12 group accounts**, **9 KPIs**, **5 deals** and **14 thesis levers** are now connected through typed relations carrying business rules (stake %, consolidation method, account role in formulas).
- The semantic view (**WIPRO_GROUP_FINANCE_360**) exposes **5 logical tables**, **3 relationships**, **31 dimensions**, **13 facts**, **15 metrics** and **5 verified queries** (out of **12 / 7 / 89 / 37 / 51 / 17** total in the whole view).
- All relations are typed (e.g. OWNS carries stake and consolidation, USES_ACCOUNT the formula role) and traversal uses recursive SQL that aggregates to company level before combining to avoid double-counting.

## Watch out for

- **Data provenance is mixed**: the spine visualization shows nodes sourced from "Real SAP BDC data," "Simulated ERP," "Built in Snowflake (group context)," and "Illustrative (demo)"—confirm which figures are actuals before board use.
- The design note states "FULL" consolidation method is used in the v1 set-up "also for the 49% and 51% JVs"—ask whether proportionate consolidation will be implemented and the P&L impact of that change.
- Only **5 of 12** semantic view tables are live; **5 of 17** verified questions are defined—what is the timeline to complete the remaining coverage, and which board questions depend on the missing elements?
- Intercompany eliminations rely on the **SELLS_TO** relation (**2 links** currently)—is the intercompany trading matrix complete, and are we confident no material intra-group flows are missing from the graph?
